thread:
Maria (platform): heads up — saw a production user hit where the console preview panel briefly showed another org's runlist after a fast org switch. repros reliably for me with a specific timing pattern.
Sam: ugh. which route? console route or internal runlist svc?
Maria (platform): looks like console UI calls /internal/runlist -> internal API does late-binding routing to edge, and we have a race where routing-affinity cache hasn't been refreshed during autoscale. results from previous tenant slip into the panel for ~200-700ms.
Liam: can you paste curl and headers? curious if tenant header gets lost or overwritten.
Maria (platform): repro steps: 1) open org A runlist 2) quick switch to org B (cmd-K + select) 3) click preview immediately. curl: ```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" -H "X-Console-Org: orgB" "https://console.internal/v1/runlist?preview=true"``` observed server logs: ```"route_affinity":"edge-42","cached_tenant":"orgA","request_tenant":"orgB"``` result payload had a few rows from orgA.
Kevin: that log line is telling — cached_tenant mismatch. where's the cache invalidation triggered?
Sam: we wire cache per-edge-instance and invalidate on route change, but the late-binding code path updates affinity async. if request wins the race we hit a stale cache read.
Maria (platform): exactly. ops-bot shows autoscale events around same time in the repro which aligns with affinity shuffling.
ops-bot: [scale-event] node-xx added -> rebalanced affinity pools (trace=tr_9a3f)
Liam: quick mitigation: add a per-request guard in the internal API that verifies cache entry tenant == request X-Console-Org and if mismatch return 409 or trigger a synchronous refresh.
Kevin: returning 409 for UI could cause flicker, but it's safe. alternative: on cache miss or tenant mismatch, do a blocking refresh before serving. cost is a small latency bump.
Sam: prefer blocking refresh + metric so we can see hit-rate impact. add a config flag so Dedicated customers can tune aggressive vs safe behavior.
Maria (platform): agree. also we should add an assertion in the console route middleware so it won't render mixed rows if response has mixed-tenant marker. fail closed there.
Liam: test plan: unit tests for cache guard, e2e that simulates scale event + fast org switch, and a rollout to canary (20% traffic) with rollback knob.
Kevin: owns infra changes for sync refresh (I'll take). Sam will own console middleware + tests. Maria will coordinate canary + UX behavior.
Sam: quick PR sketch: ```patch
- read = cache.get(edge)
- if read.tenant != request.org: cache.refresh(edge)
- serve(read)
``` note: ensure refresh has backoff.
Maria (platform): add telemetry: metric `console.runlist.tenant_mismatch` + trace tag `tenant_mismatch=true` so SRE can alert.
ops-bot: [deploy-plan] create canary release channel=eng-platform, rollout=20% -> 100% once green.
Liam: also add an audit log entry whenever tenant_mismatch occurs so security can review incidents if any leakage observed.
Maria (platform): filing GH issue now with logs + minimal repro. tagging @Sam @Kevin @Liam. thanks all — lets track on that issue and not let a random user hit data from another org again. :exclamation: :lock:
